messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in region nyc-1 — p50 latency 320ms, p95 1.8s, 5xx rate 7.2% over rolling 5m. Alert: INC-18876. Please acknowledge.

Alice Chen: acked. I'm on it. seeing spike in gateway 502/504s per edge logs.

Mateo Ruiz: I'm pulling traces from gateway and runtime. Initial glance: fanout to model variants spiked, and one backend (runtime-nyc-a) showing repeated `killed-by-oom` logs.

Priya Singh: what's customer impact? any large customers seeing errors? Samir, can you confirm support tickets?

Samir Rao: support: a handful of customers reported mid-rate failures since ~1887654200, highest impact on streaming sessions. No billing-impact alerts yet, but app UX degraded.

Nora Patel: adding live metrics: backend 5xx by type: 502 internal gateway, 504 timeout from runtime, 500 from model-server process.

Lukas Meyer: infra note: a recent autoscale event rolled out new instances on that pool ~1887654100, some kernel logs show out-of-memory throttles. Could be kernel memory pressure + swap churn.

Mateo Ruiz: reproducing snippet from proxy logs:
```
[2026-06-18T02:12:31Z] gateway-nyc: upstream runtime-nyc-a POST /v1/generate -> 502 {"errno": "EPIPE"}
[2026-06-18T02:12:32Z] gateway-nyc: upstream runtime-nyc-a POST /v1/generate -> 504 {"msg": "read timeout"}
```

Alice Chen: short-term mitigation: can we remove runtime-nyc-a from load balancer and let autoscaler spin up replacements? Will cause capacity drop but reduce 5xx noise.

Lukas Meyer: I can cordon and drain runtime-nyc-a now. Command: `infractl instance cordon runtime-nyc-a && infractl instance drain runtime-nyc-a --grace 30s`

Priya Singh: also propose activating fallback routing to model-small for non-critical routes to reduce pressure. We should enable fallback policy for api-key tier beta.

Mateo Ruiz: doing quick config change: switching route policy to prefer dedicated pool and enabling smaller-model fallback for requests with >1s queue.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: change-set rball/188765-evict-runtime -> routing-policy (rolling).

Alice Chen: after cordon/drain we should see 5xx drop. Observability: watch p95 tokens and gateway 502 counts.

Nora Patel: telemetry update: 1m after cordon, 5xx dropped to 2.1%, p95 980ms. Some residual 504s from two other nodes finishing requests.

Samir Rao: support: reducing inbound tickets; will update customers with ETA ~30m and note fallback to smaller model is in effect.

Mateo Ruiz: root cause hypothesis: a bad autoscale cycle landed heavier quantized model on nodes with insufficient memory, causing KV cache thrash -> OOMs -> request failures.

Lukas Meyer: action taken: replaced runtime-nyc-a instances, fixed kernel param for memory reservation, and temporarily lowered per-instance model concurrency from 8 -> 4.

Alice Chen: hotfix PR created to gate heavy-model placement until node health check passes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512

Priya Singh: immediate alert tuning: raising alert threshold for gateway 5xx from 3% -> 5% for 1m to reduce noise during autoscale events; also add an alert for node OOM rate. File: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/issues/230

Nora Patel: runbook gap found: current runbook assumes autoscale never places quantized-large on t4-small nodes. We'll update runbook with placement checks and cordon + fallback steps. Assign to Nora + Mateo.

Alice Chen: follow-ups / action items:
- Alice: verify rollback safety and monitor until 1887655600.
- Mateo: add more detailed trace tags to detect KV-cache thrash.
- Lukas: update autoscaler policy to prefer nodes with >X GB free before placement.
- Priya: update alerts and runbook; post link to PR/issue in this thread.
- Samir: customer comms follow-up.

Samir Rao: noted and will send a templated update to affected customers after 15m confirming mitigations.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: routing-policy rball/188765-evict-runtime -> completed.

Nora Patel: status check @1887654500: 5xx rate steady at 0.9%, p95 down to 420ms. No new OOMs observed.

Alice Chen: moving to monitoring-only in 10m if stable. Will create incident ticket and link action items.

Oncall-Handoff: handing off to night SRE oncall (Priya) — summary: mitigations applied (evict bad runtime, lower concurrency, enable smaller-model fallback, PRs/ISSUES created). Customer impact reduced, watch p95 and node oom metrics. Next steps in ticket: infra PR 512, obs issue 230, runbook update MR 118.

Priya Singh: ack. taking over monitoring and followups, will escalate if regressions.

Alice Chen: thanks everyone — documenting timeline and adding to incident tracker. :thumbsup:
